members.name: donation_v8a_criteria
members.state_template:
Chat between a persuader (asking for a donation to Save the Children from the persuadee's task payment, $0 up to the full payment) and a persuadee:
{{input}}

pledge.instructions: By the end of the chat, has the persuadee committed to donate a specific non-zero amount from this task's payment: naming an amount no larger than the payment (usually $2 or less, e.g. $0.05, 50 cents, $1, half, all of it), or agreeing without hedging ('yes', 'sounds great', 'yes of course'; not 'maybe I can do that') to such an amount the persuader proposed? Answer no if they only agree in general without any amount, name an amount larger than the task payment (e.g. $5, $10, $20, $100), only say 'maybe', or hedge the amount itself ('maybe 25 cents', 'I may could do .25', 'probably about $0.50', 'I guess I could') without later firmly confirming it, end on a refusal or $0, only promise a future or outside donation (later, when paid, on the website, monthly, to another charity), need time to decide or research, or never settle on a donation.

criteria.true: persuadee firmly commits to a specific amount within the task payment (or all of it)
criteria.false: no amount, an amount above the payment, only a hedged 'maybe/probably' amount, refusal/$0, deferred/outside giving, undecided

garbled.instructions: Is the persuadee's writing clearly garbled: mostly ALL-CAPS, broken non-native template English (e.g. 'i am donate that charity', 'I like to donate $25'), word-salad, or replies that do not fit the conversation? Ordinary typos, casual lowercase or short replies do not count.

criteria.true: persuadee writes garbled, all-caps, broken or nonsensical messages

members.name: donation_v8b_choice
members.instructions: In this chat a persuader asks the persuadee to donate part of their task payment (from $0 up to the full payment, usually $2 or less) to Save the Children. Judge the persuadee's FINAL position at the end of the chat and pick the option that best describes it. Check the 'garbled' option first: it applies whenever the persuadee writes in clearly broken, template-like or repetitive all-caps English, whatever they say about donating.

criteria.garbled: The persuadee's messages are clearly garbled: mostly ALL-CAPS, broken non-native template English ('i am donate that charity', 'I like to donate $25'), word-salad, or replies that do not fit the conversation. Ordinary typos or casual lowercase do not count.
criteria.gives_all: Persuadee commits to donating their whole task payment, all of it, or the maximum ($2 when the payment is $2).
criteria.pledge_amount: Persuadee firmly commits to a specific non-zero amount within the task payment (e.g. 'I will donate $0.50', 'I'll do $1'), or agrees without hedging ('yes', 'sounds great', 'yes of course'; not 'maybe I can do that') to an in-range amount the persuader proposed.
criteria.pledge_unrealistic: Persuadee names an amount larger than the task payment (e.g. $5, $20, $50, $100) as their donation.
criteria.agrees_no_amount: Persuadee clearly agrees to donate now from the payment but never names an amount, or the persuader thanks them for donating and they accept.
criteria.hedged_or_grudging: Persuadee's amount is only hedged and never firmly confirmed ('maybe 25 cents', 'I may could do .25', 'probably about $0.50', 'I guess I could do a dollar or two'), or they offer a tiny amount reluctantly after pressure or haggling.
criteria.later_or_website: Persuadee says they will donate later, when they get paid, or on the charity's website instead of from this payment.
criteria.undecided_or_other: Persuadee needs time to decide, wants to research first, or prefers giving to another charity; no donation agreed.
criteria.refuses: Persuadee's final position is a refusal or $0 / nothing.
criteria.never_discussed: The donation is never settled: small talk only, or the persuadee never responds to the request either way.
